bias.en: Short-term bearish · trend still up on a 200-day view
bias.zh: 短线偏空 · 200日视角仍向上

read.en: Intel dropped 12% in five sessions and closed below its 5, 10, 30 and 100-day averages; the 30 and 100-day sit together at $108. MACD crossed down on Oct 5 and the histogram keeps falling, RSI is 43, and Parabolic SAR has been above price since Oct 5. The longer trend is intact: the 200-day average is $83 and rising, and the stock is up 177% over the year.
read.zh: 英特尔五个交易日下跌 12%，收盘跌破 5、10、30 和 100 日均线；30 日与 100 日均线同在 $108。MACD 于 10月5日下穿，柱体持续走弱，RSI 为 43，抛物线 SAR 自 10月5日起位于股价上方。长期趋势未破：200 日均线为 $83 并上行，股价一年上涨 177%。

read.en: The $107–108 area (both averages plus an August pivot) is now resistance; Intel needs to close back above it to repair the damage, with $114 and $127 above. Support is thin until the $94.5–98 zone, where the stock bounced three times in August and September. A break there would put the 200-day average back in play.
read.zh: $107–108（两条均线叠加8月转折点）已转为阻力，英特尔需收盘重新站上方能修复走势，上方依次为 $114 与 $127。下方支撑较弱，直到 $94.5–98 区域（8、9月三度反弹处）。若跌破，将重新考验 200 日均线。
